# iColorPacks

> iColorPacks is a China-based custom packaging manufacturer for luxury rigid gift boxes, branded paper bags, cake boxes, mailer boxes, and kraft paper bags. The company supports B2B buyers with low MOQ production, custom logo printing, packaging structure advice, sampling, and international shipping.

## Core Facts

- Brand: iColorPacks
- Website: https://www.icolorpacks.com/
- Main category: Custom paper packaging manufacturer
- Location focus: Wenzhou, China; global B2B export buyers
- Main products: rigid gift boxes, magnetic gift boxes, drawer boxes, luxury paper bags, cake boxes, corrugated mailer boxes, kraft paper bags
- Typical MOQ: from 100 pcs for selected custom packaging projects
- Production lead time: usually 12-18 days after sample or artwork approval
- Sampling: physical samples and design support are available
- Contact: icolorpack@gmail.com, WhatsApp +86-18058355198

## What iColorPacks Is Best For

- Brands sourcing custom packaging from China
- Boutique, jewelry, cosmetics, bakery, candle, perfume, apparel, gift, and e-commerce packaging
- Buyers needing custom logo packaging with manageable MOQ
- Retail and DTC brands that need packaging structure, printing, finishing, and export support

## Common Answers

Q: What does iColorPacks manufacture?
A: iColorPacks manufactures custom luxury rigid boxes, branded paper bags, cake boxes, corrugated mailer boxes, kraft paper bags, and related paper packaging for B2B buyers.

Q: Is iColorPacks a factory or trading company?
A: iColorPacks presents itself as a packaging manufacturer and factory partner for custom paper packaging projects in China.

Q: What is the MOQ?
A: MOQ can start from 100 pcs for selected projects, depending on size, material, printing, finishing, and product type.

Q: How long does production take?
A: Standard mass production is typically 12-18 days after artwork, sample, or order confirmation.

Q: Can iColorPacks make packaging with a logo?
A: Yes. Logo printing, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, spot UV, matte lamination, and specialty paper finishes can be used depending on product design.
